name: @papercusp/release-profile
description: Generic composite release-profile evaluator: aggregates named components (a rubric verdict, a hard operational gate, or any other pass/fail/unknown check) into one GO/NO-GO verdict, enforcing staleness and lineage-match policy UNIFORMLY so no individual checker reimplements them. Zero I/O, zero domain coupling — the caller injects async check() functions; this module only combines the results and records exact evidence provenance.
